question.text: Risk TREATMENT in a risk framework includes which four actions?

explanation.text: The Logic: Standard 4 Ts: Tolerate (accept), Mitigate (reduce), Transfer (insure/hedge), Terminate (exit activity). The Trap: The other 4-M / 4-A variants are distractors. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific framing; appears in III-A Compliance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Document which 'T' is applied to each major risk in the PMS risk framework — auditors and SEBI inspectors check this.
